The balance sheet looks strong: liquidity is solid (current ratio 2.29) and capitalization is conservative, with equity covering about 59% of assets and total liabilities only about 40% of assets. Profitability is also healthy (EBIT about 6.5% of assets), supporting an upper-medium investment-grade assessment, though the limited information on cash flow, debt structure, and coverage argues against the very highest categories.

DECISION: A
